فَأَصْبَحُوا فِى دَارِهِمْ جَاثِمِينَ , in the Kur [vii. 76, &c.], means [And they became, in their abode,] bodies cast upon the ground: (TA:) or extinct, or motionless; and dead. (Bd.) ―
-b2- الجُثثومُ (tropical:) The stars composing the constellation of the Scorpion; also called البُرُكُ: see بَرْكْ. (L and TA in art. برك.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
